**Policy.** Any correction found in native PowerPoint is applied to the GENERATOR and followed by a complete regeneration, structural QA re-run, full re-render and visual inspection. The PPTX is never hand-patched: a hand patch would be lost on the next build and would break the guarantee that every string in the deck exists in the controlled model.
